findings.original_observation: The first formatter draft shifted indentation inside checked HTML, which changed whitespace Text nodes. Its semantic before/after guard rejected the write.
findings.fix: Keep HTML body lines byte-preserved while normalizing the enclosing Diamond source block.
findings.replay: F1-format-valid-preserves-content-and-checks and the formatter unit test pass; the second format is byte-identical.

findings.original_observation: A function result mismatch pointed to the function declaration at 1:1 instead of the final mismatched expression at 3:3.
findings.fix: Use the final statement location for function result mismatches, retaining the declaration location only for an empty body.
findings.replay: D1 single-file and project-module diagnostics now point at the mismatched expression with code, caret, and remedy.

findings.original_observation: The first real Chrome failure exposed the compiler-qualified internal component symbol before `.fail`.
findings.fix: Emit a separate compiler-owned public handler-label map while retaining the qualified key for runtime lookup and source mapping.
findings.replay: Actual Chrome displayed `Contract.fail`; the following Recover event succeeded and cleared the error.
